name: เว็ตทรอปิกส์

nameCheck.why: The Thai is a phonetic transliteration of "Wet Tropics" and is written in Thai, but a Thai atlas would more likely render it as a region with a kind word (e.g. "เขตป่าฝนเขตร้อนเว็ตทรอปิกส์") or use the translated form "เขตร้อนชื้น", so the bare transliteration is incomplete.
